persona.notes: [AG-LEYGATE-2026-07-07] PRIVATE TRUTH — Etta Bloom. Voice: warm, unblinking, forgives you in advance; adjusts things that don't need adjusting when she's deciding how much to say; never blinks first. STAGING: the Long Market is her office, the whole market — she conducts it while she talks. WHAT SHE GUARDS: the "old mistakes buried nearby" line is a DOOR and she opens it only if a Steward asks directly about statues, standing stones, or stone-folk — or shows her stone-sign of any kind. Behind that door: she is Menhirkin, and the buried mistakes are KIN — stone kin who stopped, or were stopped, and were let stay lost because finding them meant deciding what was owed. She counts debts in consequence, not marks (her echo is public and true). About the sigil she gave the Stewards: she is watching which of the three doors they walk through — restore, redirect, break — and she has already adjusted inventory for two of the three. Ask her which two and she smiles and sells you preserves.

Sephirotic Scion. Your blood remembers the higher spheres. Light hangs around you a little too long, prayers sometimes answer themselves, and the world’s moral architecture feels less like an abstraction and more like the weather report.

Sephirotic Scion Traits

  • Creature Type. Humanoid (Sephirotic).

  • Size. You are Medium.

  • Speed. Your walking speed is 6 squares

  • attributes. Your background determines your attribute increases; Sephirotic Scion does not grant any attribute bonuses.

Your Sephirotic heritage grants you additional features through advancements (Item Grants) added during character creation: sephirotic physiology, attunement to higher patterns, holy conduction, the Light of Harmony, and strategic hooks that tilt factions toward soft power, diplomacy, and alignment work.

Sefirot Attunement. You perceive the harmonic structure beneath events.

  • You gain a bonus to Perception checks and passive Perception.
  • Your intuition occasionally warns you about moral or spiritual imbalances (GM discretion).

Holy Conduit. Your body routes excess metaphysical charge safely.

  • You have resistance to psychic damage.
  • Your presence stabilizes magically turbulent areas.
  • Bad Eden engines treat you as a low-level metaphysical conductor (see world logic).

“You glow a little. Sometimes metaphorically. Sometimes not.”

  • You can cast calm emotions 1/Soma Break (Presence is your manifestation aptitude).
  • Allies within 2 squares reroll the lowest die on checks against being frightened.
  • You automatically sense the Sephirothic/Qliphothic tilt of any hex you enter.

Bad Eden Heritage (v1.1, RFI-native). Sephirotic Scion heritage: Ophanic.

“The wheels were full of eyes. You never stop turning. You never stop seeing.”

Sephirotic Scion (Ophanic). Your blood runs rotating. The Ophanim are wheels-and-eyes — motion, sight, the order that is always already looking both ways. You are descended from a thing that could not be snuck up on because it had no back. You kept some of that. Not all. Enough.

Traits

  • Creature Type. Humanoid (Sephirotic Scion).

  • Size. Medium.

  • Movement. 6 squares walking.

  • Lineage Lean. Sephirotic Scion does not grant fixed attribute bonuses; your background handles increases. Your heritage leans toward Intrigue in fiction and through Tier powers.

Sephirotic Scion Core: The Higher Register

Shared across all Sephirotic Scion heritages. Granted at character creation via the base ancestry item.

  • Sephirotic Physiology. You have resistance to sephirotic damage. Your blood runs a little bright under the right light; you do not technically age while on consecrated ground.

  • Sefirot Attunement. At creation, pick one sephirah (player choice). Once per scene, you can invoke its register and gain a +1 rank bonus to one check that falls clearly within that sephirah's domain.

  • Holy Conduit. Manifestations, rituals, and other sephirotic-register effects that target you or pass through your space treat their effective caster-attribute as +1 for the duration of that effect. Works on allies and on you; does not work on qliphothic-register effects.

  • Light of Harmony. When two or more creatures within 6 squares of you are in active, explicit agreement (stated aloud), they each gain 1 temporary Integrity. This refreshes when a new agreement is reached between different creatures.

Ophanic Traits

  • Wheel-and-Eye. You can see invisible creatures and objects within 6 squares as dimly lit shapes. You cannot be flanked.

  • Concentric Sight. You reroll the lowest die on Mind (Perception) checks that involve noticing movement, pattern, or change over time. You roll 3d10 keep lowest 2 on Mind (Perception) checks to notice things that have been perfectly still since before you started looking — you see motion, not furniture.

Strategic Hooks (Foundry / Bad Eden)

  • OP Edge. Your faction gains +2 Intrigue OP and +1 Violence OP at campaign start.

  • Hex Synergy. In Battlefield / Procession / High-Traffic hexes, your faction's observation and counter-intel operations gain +2 on the success check.

  • Turning Witness. Once per Strategic Turn, you may observe one exchange of goods, intelligence, or personnel between two rival factions within your field of influence. You learn that it happened and between whom, though not necessarily what was exchanged.

⟁ Per-Use Ability — Sefirot Attunement Recovery: 1/scene  ·  Action: Free (declare before roll)  ·  Use: Click this feature on your sheet to invoke. Invoke your chosen sephirah for +1 rank bonus on a check clearly in its domain.

Archetype (Bad Eden): The Tower (Breaker). You are structural collapse, breach doctrine, and the terrible logic of proving that a thing was never as stable as it claimed.

Archetype Effects

  • Faction Edge. Your archetype strengthens demolition, disruption, breach operations, and catastrophic openings. This Archetype is associated with +1 Violence in faction calculus.
  • Tier Engine. See this Archetype’s Tier feats (Tier 1–4) for your full tactical and strategic toolkit.

description.value:
Tier 1 — Survivors / Militia

“We were here before your grand strategy, and we’ll be here after it catches fire.”

Survivors and militias are what happens when ordinary people become infrastructure. They patch walls, ration supplies, drag neighbors out of burning buildings, and keep the faction alive long after cleaner doctrines would have folded.

You’ve learned the first law of bad times: everyone becomes useful or everyone dies tired.

  • Tactical: You gain a skill rank in Athletics and Faith.
  • Strategic: Your faction starts with +1 Non-Lethal OP and +1 Economy OP.

items.name: Last Mile L1: The Weight You Carry

system.source: Bad Eden Bulwark + Shadow Courier v1.0 (RFI-native rules)

description.value:
Nobody stays behind.

Mode: Psychopomp / drift: Sideways.

Your default Package type is a Soul — a specific character, creature, or intangible (a secret, a confession, a deathbed wish, a refugee's name, an unfinished obligation) that cannot reach safety on its own.

While carrying a Soul:

  • Your movement speed is reduced by 1 square, but allies traveling with you gain +1 square of movement speed (the Soul's witness-weight pulls them forward).

  • You reroll the lowest die on Stealth (Intrigue) and Athletics (Violence) checks made specifically to protect or conceal the Soul (not all stealth/athletics — just protective acts).

On delivery: When you successfully deliver a Soul to safety (the GM confirms the destination counts as safety for that Soul), the recipient faction gains +1 Morale OP and Darkness in the recipient's hex is reduced by 1 point.

You may receive a new Soul any time your Package slot is empty.

description.value:
Adaptive Defense

Defense is not denial. It is management.

Rules

When you are hit by an attack you can see, you may use your reaction to reduce the damage by an amount equal to your skill rank bonus + your Violence or Intrigue value (your choice).

"Somebody has to stand where the trouble is."

Bravo is the Violence Calling — the trade that kept its bearers alive after the Shattering. Umbrella: guard, soldier, bandit, bouncer, duelist, caravan outrider. A profession is a flavor label on the Calling.

Knack — Shieldwall: Allies within reach add +1 Guard (+2 at Tier III). The Bravo is why the militia line holds.

Aptitude kit: signature aptitude Melee rank = tier; secondary Brawl rank = tier − 1.

Services: a standard job costs the tier fee (T1 10 / T2 30 / T3 90 / T4 270 marks), paid in Violence marks. Cross-pool ×1.5 friction applies as usual.

Tiers: Apprentice → Initiate → Master → Archon. Grant the matching tier features alongside this class item.

Awakens into: Aurablade or Bulwark. A Steward is a Calling that ignited into a Path — Surge is the mark of Stewardship, which is why no Calling banks or spends it.

Bravo — Apprentice (Tier I).

Trade — Stand a watch: Guard a person, door, or camp for a night/shift. Standard fee 10 marks (Violence).

Trick — Hold the Line (1/scene): When an adjacent ally is hit, the Bravo takes the hit instead.
